decisions.reason: The multi-model lever family carries tooling and catalogue investment, and the firm has already justified it as part of its core handle range, so management persists even though its website presence has not been visible since 2018.
As a single design close to the established offer it costs little to keep, but its absence from the website since 2018 makes a range cleanup more plausible than for the product lines.
This single handle design is inexpensive to maintain, and management can still attribute weak results to the pandemic-related construction slowdown, so it stays despite little recent visibility.
The lever family embodies sunk investment across several models and supports the announced push toward system breadth, which favours keeping it.
The L700 access system is the publicly announced flagship of the firm's digital building direction with heavy investment, so management will stick with it and treat any disappointment as temporary.
